name: video-blur-vignette

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the forest clip clearly framed with the soft edges visible and no cursor.

tagline: A looping forest clip plays inside a frame with softly blurred edges.
summary: An autoplaying, muted forest video fills a rounded frame whose edges blur and fade into the page. The centre stays sharp, and the footage zooms slightly when hovered.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle showing sunlit tall trees, a mossy trunk at the left and green ferns below, spanning nearly the full width on a black page. The outer band of the footage is soft and slightly dimmed, so the frame melts into the background.
behaviour: The muted forest clip loops on its own from the moment it loads. Hovering zooms the footage in a little; otherwise the only change is the drifting sunlight and foliage as the video plays.
demo_content: A sunlit pine forest with a mossy foreground trunk and ferns on a bright day.
search_phrases: soft frame around a playing clip
rounded video that fades at borders
looping background clip with soft border
video card with zoom on hover
framed motion footage for a hero
use_when: You want looping footage to blend into a dark page instead of sitting in a hard-edged box.
avoid_when: It relies on a remote MP4, so the frame stays empty if that host is blocked or offline.
customise: The video source URL and its classes are written into the component, so swap the MP4 there. Radius, inset, fade length and blur come from the vignette wrapper props.
weight_why: Backdrop blur is recomputed over a looping video on every frame.

a11y.note: The clip loops with no pause control and no captions, and it ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: The clip autoplays and loops with no pause control for the viewer.
The video loads from a remote URL, so the frame stays empty if that host is blocked.
The frames never show the hover zoom that the code adds.
polish_why: Pleasant soft-edged footage; it is a plain framed video with little beyond the blur.
title: Video Blur Vignette
